content:
If one looks at Wikipedia and projects like the nlab - they have a feature which I think we are lacking. The ability to add comments or talk about specific pages/files. I think this might be useful as if linked to from the Physlib files themselves, they will provide an easy way for people 1) to write there thoughts on a given implementation or results, 2) see what else people are saying about a given area.

Do people think this would be useful? If so, do people know of a Zulip-native or GitHub-native way we could achieve this?
It looks like github discussions would be a quick solution.
@Gregory Loges Thanks - I will look into this to see if it would fit with what I have in mind. Seems like the difficulty would be to easily connect the files to the discussion threads.
